data.text: Live run, criterion 7: eight Sonnet agents in natural mode, one per held-out question (indices 2,8,14,20,26,32,38,44: 3 decisions, 3 docs, 1 task, 1 note), CLAUDE.md already carrying the --also line, the prompt never naming it. Correct 8/8, every one opened with kadence search, 2-6 tool calls. --also used: 0 of 8 — the two that needed a second try searched again in other words instead. So the line in the instruction file did not change the habit, as KAD-53 found for search itself; subagents never see the prompt hook's tail, which is where it is named live. Smaller than KAD-50's 40 agents and with no forced/forbidden arms, so it measures adoption only. Waiting on the owner: --json gains 'also' (additive) — criterion 2 left for the suite run after approval.
